transport error and inappropriate formal acceptance claims are refused
actual zero exit retains full output and registered own group cleanup

preexisting exclusive log refuses before spawning

actual ignored TERM reaches KILL within a finite deadline

actual supervisor TERM cancels and disposes its separately detached registered child
actual exited parent orphan is cleaned only within its registered group
actual independent sentinel group remains alive during timeout cleanup
direct-child migration records its incomplete descendant scope honestly
actual own-group observation excludes only its separately grouped observer
pending readiness promises have a finite rejection deadline

control driver helper runner and workflow inputs stay byte-exact through execution
